sources.label: UCI Online Retail II
sources.provenance: UCI Machine Learning Repository / Kaggle cgrymn/online-retail-ii-uci-dataset
sources.evidence: Column names (Invoice, StockCode, Description, Quantity, InvoiceDate, Price, Customer ID, Country) match documented UCI Online Retail II schema exactly. Date range 2009-12-01 to 2011-12-09 matches the documented UCI dataset period.
sources.note: No inventory, lead time, reorder point, safety stock, or promotion flag. These are genuinely absent from the UCI source.

sources.label: Repository Synthetic Retail (internally generated)
sources.evidence: File generated by src/generate_synthetic_retail.py using NumPy random processes. Row count 1,461,000 = 10 stores × 100 SKUs × 1461 days. Store IDs follow STORE_001 pattern; US city names. SKU IDs follow SKU_00001 pattern.
sources.kaggle_equivalence: NOT PROVEN — this is NOT the Kaggle Synthetic Retail 10M dataset
sources.note: The generator script declares capacity for 30 stores / 5000 SKUs but the actual parquet data was produced with num_stores=10, num_skus=100. This is an internal inconsistency.

sources.label: Kaggle Synthetic Retail Dataset — 10 Million Transactions
sources.status: not_loaded — file not present in data/raw/
sources.evidence: No file in data/raw/ or data/processed/ contains 10 million rows matching this dataset. The generator script produces its own synthetic data independently.
sources.note: If this dataset is to be used for retraining, a Phase 17 data integration phase is required.
